title: Bowling Game with Time Control
prompt:
Create a single HTML file containing a 3D bowling game with time-control mechanics using Three.js and Cannon.js (or custom physics). Load the 'Corset.glb' model using GLTFLoader from Three.js CDN as a decorative trophy object displayed on a pedestal beside the lane.

## Scene Setup
- Use a perspective camera at position (0, 8, 18) looking toward (0, 0, -15).
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light at (5, 15, 10) with intensity 0.8 and shadows enabled.
- Create a bowling lane: a long box (width 3.5, height 0.2, length 30) colored #C4A46C (wood), centered at (0, 0, -10).
- Add gutter channels on each side of the lane (dark gray, slightly lower).
- Place 10 bowling pins in standard triangle formation at z = -22. Pins are white cylinders (radius 0.15, height 0.6) with a slight taper. Each pin is a physics body with mass 0.5.
- Create a bowling ball: sphere radius 0.35, color #222244, starting at position (0, 0.55, 4). Mass = 5.
- Load 'Corset.glb' and place it on a small pedestal (box 1x1x1, gold color) at position (4, 0.5, 5). Scale the model to fit roughly 1 unit tall. This is the trophy.

## Physics
- Implement simple physics: gravity = -9.81 on Y axis.
- Pins should topple when hit by the ball. A pin is 'knocked down' if its Y-axis tilt exceeds 45 degrees from vertical (i.e., the dot product of its up vector with world Y < 0.707).
- The ball rolls along the lane with friction. If the ball goes into the gutter (|x| > 1.75), it falls off and the throw is wasted.
- Ball stops or is reset after reaching z < -25 or after 5 seconds post-throw.

## Time Control System
- Implement a time scale variable (default 1.0). The physics dt is multiplied by this scale.
- Press 'T' to toggle slow motion: time scale cycles through 1.0 → 0.25 → 0.1 → 1.0.
- Press 'P' to pause/unpause the simulation entirely (timeScale = 0 when paused).
- Display current time scale on a HUD element with id='timeDisplay'.

## User Interactions
- **Aiming**: Press 'A' and 'D' (or ArrowLeft/ArrowRight) to move the ball left/right along x-axis (clamped to [-1.5, 1.5]) before throwing.
- **Power**: Press 'W' or ArrowUp to increase throw power (range 5 to 25, step 1, default 15). Press 'S' or ArrowDown to decrease. Show power on HUD element id='powerDisplay'.
- **Throw**: Press Space to throw the ball. Ball gets velocity (0, 0, -power) in world units/sec. Can only throw once per frame (no re-throw until reset).
- **Spin**: Before throwing, press 'Q' for left spin, 'E' for right spin. Spin adds a lateral velocity component: spin * 2.0 on x-axis applied gradually during travel. Spin range [-3, 3], step 1, default 0.
- **Reset**: Press 'R' to reset all pins to standing, ball to start, score for current frame to 0, thrown = false.

## Scoring & Frames
- Track knocked-down pins after each throw.
- Support 2 throws per frame, 3 frames total (simplified game).
- After first throw, count knocked pins. If all 10 = strike, frame ends.
- After second throw, count additionally knocked pins.
- Spare = all 10 down across 2 throws.
- Display: frame number (id='frameDisplay'), throw number (id='throwDisplay'), pins knocked this frame (id='pinsDisplay'), total score (id='scoreDisplay').

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- ballPosition: {x, y, z} current ball position
- ballThrown: boolean
- throwPower: number (current power setting)
- spinValue: number
- timeScale: number (current time scale)
- paused: boolean
- pinsDown: number (pins knocked in current frame)
- currentFrame: number (1-3)
- currentThrow: number (1 or 2)
- totalScore: number
- isStrike: boolean
- isSpare: boolean
- pinStates: array of 10 booleans (true = still standing)
- trophyLoaded: boolean (true once Corset.glb is loaded)
- gameOver: boolean (true after frame 3 completes)
- gutterBall: boolean (true if ball went into gutter)

## HUD
- Position HUD elements in top-left corner with white text, dark semi-transparent background.
- Include all display elements mentioned above.
- Add a 'STRIKE!' or 'SPARE!' notification (id='notification') that appears for 2 seconds when achieved.
physics_constraints: Gravity -9.81 m/s² on Y. Pin knockdown threshold: up-vector dot Y < 0.707 (45° tilt). Ball mass 5, pin mass 0.5. Friction on lane surface. Gutter boundary at |x| > 1.75. Time scale affects physics dt multiplicatively.
